topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I shouldn't have been so quick to judge. When I saw the similarities between the submitted paper and the online source, my reaction was harsh, too harsh. I overlooked the effort, thelate nights, and the genuineinterest in the subject. Now, facing the student's tearful explanation of a misunderstanding, a simple oversight, I realize the weight of my words. I should have started with a question, not an accusation. It's too late to take back the doubts I cast, the trust I questioned. I can only promise to be more thoughtful, more considerate, in the future. It’s a lesson in the power of presuming fault before seeking understanding.
